title: As Long as Life Endures: A Climber Wedding
original_title: As Long as Life Endures: A Climber Wedding
overview: In July 2016, Cheyne Lempe poetically filmed the mountain wedding of climbers Sara Aranda and Patrick Hodge, after their ascent of The Incredible Hulk in the Hoover Wilderness in the Sierra Nevada via the Red Dihedral route (5.10b). At the summit, photographer and climber Drew Smith awaited them to officiate their marriage.
